title: Optional: Read the Faction Signal
briefing: Faction signals can become contacts later. For now, scan signs, read the dossier, and avoid turning a first contact into a fight.

objectives.label: Scan a faction sign or route board
objectives.detail: Crashbreak and Radwarden markers should identify the contact type and risk.

objectives.label: Read the faction field dossier
objectives.detail: Check whether the route expects observation, trade, or avoidance.

objectives.label: Mark the contact route
objectives.detail: Use the HoloMap marker for later, then leave before the area escalates.

completionText: Faction signal logged. You have a contact lead without committing to a faction route yet.
